ns2:section.sectionText: The course addresses major themes, movements, genres, aesthetics, and approaches to filmmaking and film production in Scandinavia since the early 1990s. Divided into sections, the course will address films and industry practices of relevance in particular to the following: Globalization, Environment and Nature (including the Arctic), Gender and Sexuality, Hollywood remakes, and director Lars von Trier. Screenings on Mondays, lecture and discussion on Wednesdays. Assigned readings, regular writing assignments, and a research project. Meets with MACS/SCAN 492.
